title: App frozen and nothing works? Fix it in 1 second! 🧊⚡ #Shorts
description:
An app froze and won't respond? Open Task Manager instantly and force it to close! 🙌

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + Shift + Esc, then pick the frozen app and click End task
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Option + Esc, then pick the app and click Force Quit

Tip: save your other work first, because force closing an app loses its unsaved changes.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
